# IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalent

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalentInspection`

Adding or subtracting the literal `1` to a variable and storing it back
(`$n += 1`, `$n = $n - 1`, …) is more idiomatically written with the increment
or decrement operator.

## Example

Options `PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE = false`, `PREFER_SUFFIX_STYLE = true`:

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,12,14} [Before]
<?php

$page += 1;
$this->left -= 1;
$total = 1 + $total;
$total = $total + 1;
self::$depth = self::$depth - 1;
$total = 1 - $total;
$total = $total + 1.0;

$slots = [0, 0];
$slots[1] += 1;

while (true) { $n = $n - 1; }
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

$page++;
$this->left--;
$total++;
$total++;
self::$depth--;
$total = 1 - $total;
$total = $total + 1.0;

$slots = [0, 0];
$slots[1]++;

while (true) { $n--; }
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;$page++&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;$this-&gt;left--&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;$total++&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;$total++&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;self::$depth--&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 12: Use &#39;$slots[1]++&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 14: Use &#39;$n--&#39; instead.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE | bool | true | Fix produces `++$x` / `--$x`. |
| PREFER_SUFFIX_STYLE | bool | false | Mutually exclusive with the above (radio choice); fix produces `$x++` / `$x--` whenever `PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE` is false. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalent": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE": true,
        "PREFER_SUFFIX_STYLE": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalent

/**
 * @noinspection IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalentInspection
 */
```
